```sql
WITH tenant_customers AS (
    SELECT c.id,
           c.email,
           c.company,
           c.country_code
      FROM customers c
     WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           sum(o.total_cents) AS revenue,
           count(*)           AS order_count,
           max(o.created_at)  AS last_order_at
      FROM orders o
      JOIN tenant_customers tc ON tc.id = o.customer_id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
     GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT tc.id,
       tc.email,
       tc.company,
       tc.country_code,
       cs.revenue,
       cs.order_count,
       cs.last_order_at
  FROM tenant_customers tc
  JOIN customer_stats cs ON cs.customer_id = tc.id
 WHERE cs.last_order_at >= %(from)s
   AND cs.last_order_at <  %(to)s
 ORDER BY cs.revenue DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

Het origineel aggregeerde eerst alle geldige orders van alle tenants en filterde pas daarna op tenant. Deze versie beperkt de orderscan tot de klanten van de gevraagde tenant, en vervangt DISTINCT ON door max(created_at), wat dezelfde waarde oplevert. Tie-breaking bij gelijke omzet blijft gelijk aan het origineel, omdat de ORDER BY hetzelfde is gebleven.
